title: POST /tutor response contract (spec_version 1.0)
description: Source: competition/SPEC.md §3–§4 (authoritative). Exactly answer, action, citations, nothing else. answer is at most 4,000 Unicode characters. action is one of the 7 lowercase values. citations are KB section IDs, the file names of kb/<subject>/<ID>.md (e.g. FIN-02-01); never a CSV (<ID>-table<n>) or the HTML copy (FIN-01); [] when none, never null. Every failure path returns this shape with HTTP 200 (TU-01, TU-12); only an auth failure is non-200. Tests check responses against this schema and competition/grader/scoring.parse_tutor.
